verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for an email SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows internal triggers ('draft replies when emails arrive') and outbound integrations via MCP and Zapier, but nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec, so this is an adjacent capability rather than webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
